mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 7 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 7.

Tens of thousands gathered in Delhi to protest against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government, with the opposition Congress leading the demonstrations.

McLaren announced its next supercar, the McL 820, which will deliver about 809 metric horsepower and replace the 750S model.

Credit borrowing costs are climbing sharply in North Macedonia, pushing higher interest rates on new loans for both households and businesses.

OpenAI chief Sam Altman warned that up to 40 percent of personal-computer RAM could end up in the hands of OpenAI, criticizing current RAM usage practices.

Kylian Mbappé set a La Liga record by scoring against every opponent his Real Madrid side has faced in the Spanish championship.
